description: Model registry — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for tag -> model_id AND pricing, across every host this marketplace is emitted for (ADR-0022): the `gemini-*` entries at the end are the Antigravity families, reference/pin-only like the dated Claude pins, priced so telemetry can value a run that RECORDS them without any of them ever being dispatched by tag. A `tag` is the short alias used across local files and the plugin (agent `.md` frontmatter `model: <tag>`); `model_id` is the real Claude model string, used both to invoke the model and for telemetry. `pricing` (USD per MTok: input/cached_input/output) is authoritative for telemetry cost accounting — the pipeline reads it from here, never restates rates elsewhere. `cache_write_multipliers` price prompt-cache CREATION relative to the model's input rate (Anthropic standard: 5-minute TTL = 1.25x, 1-hour TTL = 2x); the usage tool multiplies the per-turn ephemeral_5m/ephemeral_1h cache-creation token split by these. To bump a model or its price, edit it HERE (README/CORE-TODO/SKILL link here). `pipeline_tiers` lists the tags the pipeline actually dispatches and that hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh enforces (mirror of its is_valid_tier list — keep in sync); the remaining `models` entries are reference/pin-only.

estimation_baselines._comment: Per-dispatch token baselines for the Step 1d-1 dry-run cost preview ONLY — never for billing or the cost cap, which use transcript-derived actuals (ADR-0005/0011). Derived from the median of 56 transcript-priced phases across 10 real runs, excluding `development` (see its phase multiplier in SKILL.md 1d-1). Note the shape: uncached `input` is negligible while `cache_read` dominates — a phase is a multi-turn agent loop that re-reads its whole prefix every turn, which the pre-2026-07 baseline (35k input, 60% cached, single call) did not model at all and so under-reported real cost by 6-10x. Priced with the same formula as usage.mjs priceUsage, including cache_write_multipliers. Re-derive when the agent roster or prompt sizes change materially.
estimation_baselines._fable_note: No fable run has been measured; it inherits the opus token shape and is priced at its own registry rates.

pricing.note: Gemini 3.1 Pro, ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (read 2026-09-09). Rates are for prompts <= 200K tokens; ABOVE 200K Google charges $4.00 input / $18.00 output / $0.40 cached, which this registry cannot express — it has one rate per model, not a prompt-size tier. That is not hypothetical here: real phases have exceeded a 200K prefix, so a run priced from these numbers UNDER-reports. Do not enable cost on this host until the tier is representable (Track J Phase 4). Effort does not change the token price, so the -high and -low aliases carry identical rates. Cache STORAGE ($4.50/MTok/hour) is not modelled at all.
Same model and rates as gemini-3.1-pro-high; see that entry's note for the >200K tier caveat.

Gemini 3.8 Flash, ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (read 2026-09-09). INTRODUCTORY pricing through 2026-12-31; from 2027-01-01 it doubles to $1.50 input / $7.50 output / $0.15 cached. Update this entry then, or every Antigravity run after that date is priced at half of what it cost. Effort does not change the token price, so the -high/-medium/-low aliases carry identical rates.
Same model and rates as gemini-3.8-flash-high; see that entry's note for the 2027-01-01 price change.
